reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I couldn't check the 23 May date because I can't see any Thornbury Cloth Co. files from their access.

My reply says:
- I'm treating the date as unconfirmed for now.
- 23 May has already passed this year (it's 14 Oct 2026), so either they meant May 2027 or someone misheard.
- Pree should get the date in writing from their Thornbury contact before anyone plans around it, and I offered to help draft that ask.

The deadline is only a date, not a money figure, so no approval was needed. I didn't record it anywhere as a confirmed fact.
